task_spec.text: Find the engineering-channel thread about the circuit-tracer OOM/PyTorch-rewrite issue, identify who authored the anchor message and its direct replies, and report each of their workspace roles.

access_plan: Use conversations.list/conversations.history on the engineering channel to locate the message describing circuit-tracer OOM errors and the PyTorch rewrite proposal, then conversations.replies on that anchor ts to enumerate its direct replies and their authors.
